review.notes: Accepted: all ten frames show Echo Catwalk as a medium-brown adult man with teal headband, short dark-teal hair, trimmed beard, teal kit, knee pads and teal-black shoes. Continuous controlled fall and recovery, no ball or props. Figure scale/identity remain consistent. Source rendered a dark background despite transparency request; component isolation packaging removes it.

ballPolicy: No ball in frames. Echo-specific ball track must be authored independently in the game runtime; this atlas contains no ball.
cleanup: package-echo-action10.py performs per-pose connected-component isolation, transparent-background cleanup, uniform scale and baseline placement.
